items.name: Fluid Speech Pro
items.fact: official release: open ASR (speech-to-text) model under 1B params, claims #2 on Hugging Face OpenASR leaderboard, supports 25 languages

items.name: Voder
items.fact: now open source; coding agent by VeriLoop team (Tsinghua SIGS robotics lab support) that runs independent verification of proposed code changes before writing them to the workspace

items.name: Budget3D
items.fact: research paper shared on HF papers: image-to-3D generation at any token budget; research result, not a product launch

items.name: DeepSeek API 全功能（App 能力开放）
items.fact: DeepSeek App capabilities (search, files, links, safety, voice) now available through DeepSeek API via parameters; standalone OCR, ASR, TTS APIs. Feature/API update, not a new model

items.name: Claude Code 桌面自定义主题（mods）
items.fact: Claude Code desktop supports custom themes via mods: change colors, animated background; ask Claude or use theme-examples plugin. Feature update

items.name: Claude Code Projects 协调器升级
items.fact: Projects in Claude Code: a coordinator runs tasks across parallel threads; now more proactive, answers questions in project chat and reports thread status. Feature update

items.name: PARDIG / SatWeave
items.fact: Google DeepMind releases PARDIG and SatWeave, the foundational atmospheric observation datasets behind WeatherNext 3 weather forecasting, for researchers/developers. Dataset release

items.name: Gemini Personal Intelligence 接入 Google Wallet
items.fact: Gemini Personal Intelligence (connects info from user's apps for personalized answers) adds Google Wallet as a connected app. Feature update
